purpose: Artifact integrity, source binding and locator checks. This report does not certify the theorem or formal proofs.

return_archive.manifest: MANIFEST.sha256 covers every other return file; it intentionally does not hash itself.
return_archive.note: The final archive was reopened, CRC-tested, extracted to a fresh directory and checked with the included validator before delivery. Its own hash is excluded here to avoid a self-reference.

scope_limits: No Lean build or Comparator execution was performed.
Existing supplied PDF pages were rasterized for inspection; no manuscript was compiled into a fresh PDF.
The large historical trace and the full long record were not read cover to cover; sources_read records precise scope.
Archive validation checks data integrity and exact quotations, not the truth of every mathematical judgment.
reproduce: From the extracted return, run: python validate_return.py
For exact source quotations and input hashes too, run: python validate_return.py --input /path/to/quartic_r7_quantum_specialists.zip
To check the ZIP itself, add: --package /path/to/quartic_r7_quantum_specialists_return.zip
